summary: The test of late canonical and batch metadata corrections drains the publication queue before comparing with the recompute, as the other publication fact tests do, so a commit's 10ms loan that leaves one claim pending no longer fails it under load

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Test-only change; no product code, wire format or CLI contract changes.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.
